text:
Well, if you really

want a confession,

here it is:

I have had thirty-six lovers.

Well, yes. You are right...

that is too many.

Thirty-five would have been enough.

But, darling, the thirty-sixth

is you.

translation.title: Well, If You Really
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the comic setup and the intimate snap of the last two lines.
